Package neqsim.process.util.scenario

Class CompressorAutomationStudy.TrainProcess

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.processmodel.ProcessSystem
neqsim.process.util.scenario.CompressorAutomationStudy.TrainProcess
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface
Enclosing class:
CompressorAutomationStudy
public static final class CompressorAutomationStudy.TrainProcess extends ProcessSystem
Native process subtype with a deliberately fixed execution order for this cyclic finite-volume template.

All actual physical units remain registered for ordinary engineering lookup and P&ID projection. Generic adaptive/parallel execution and addition of unrelated equipment are outside this template contract.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • runTransient

      public void runTransient(double dt, UUID id)
      Advances one transient process timestep.

      Setter units execute once as a dedicated pre-step specification phase through their transient contract. They are excluded from subsequent equipment integration passes so explicit, semi-implicit, and parallel stepping apply each setter once and advance its clock by exactly dt.

      Specified by:
      runTransient in interface SimulationInterface
      Overrides:
      runTransient in class ProcessSystem
      Parameters:
      dt - timestep in seconds
      id - calculation identifier shared by the timestep
